The operations are `POST /retention-runs`, which starts a run and answers `202 Accepted` with `runId`, or `409` for an active run, and `GET /retention-runs/{runId}`, which returns the run record; both are on `/api/recovery/source-data/v1`.

edits.new:
No other table is named in the contract, no table of another service is read and no cross-schema key exists (DP-01).

P5 (rwb_document) owns `retention_rule`, `retention_action`, the load, the retention Schedule and the document archive; this service holds no rule table and no Schedule. Each owner applies the rule to its own schema: this service receives the rule version, the run date and the rules in the run request, validates them against its own tables and applies them to its own eight tables. The run is started through `POST /retention-runs` and its run record is read through `GET /retention-runs/{runId}`.
